title: "Differential gene expression analysis"

  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
    echo: true

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(snakemake, ".deg.Rmd.RDS")

library(data.table)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

# ----------------------------
# Input data
# Read merged count matrix
count_matrix <- read.csv(
  snakemake@input$counts,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Read samplesheet
samplesheet <- fread(snakemake@input$samples)

# Ensure phenotype factor and reference level
samplesheet$phenotype <- relevel(
  factor(samplesheet$phenotype),
  ref = "WT"
)

# Match order between samples and counts
rownames(samplesheet) <- samplesheet$ID
samplesheet <- samplesheet[colnames(count_matrix), ]

# ----------------------------
# Create DESeq2 object
# ----------------------------

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData = samplesheet,
  design = ~ phenotype
)

# Filter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts")

# ----------------------------
# Raw counts distribution
# ----------------------------

melted_counts <- melt(as.matrix(counts(dds)),
                      varnames = c("Gene", "ID"),
                      value.name = "Count")

ggplot(melted_counts, aes(x = ID, y = Count)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

# ----------------------------
# Variance stabilizing transformation
# ----------------------------

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

melted_vsd_counts <- melt(as.matrix(assay(vsd)),
                          varnames = c("Gene", "ID"),
                          value.name = "Count")

ggplot(melted_vsd_counts, aes(x = ID, y = Count)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

# ----------------------------
# Dispersion plot
# ----------------------------

plotDispEsts(dds)

# ----------------------------
# PCA
# ----------------------------

plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "phenotype") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA of VST counts")

# ----------------------------
# Heatmap of top 500 variable genes
# ----------------------------

vars <- apply(assay(vsd), 1, var)
top <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:500]
mat <- assay(vsd)[top, ]

ann_col <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd)[, "phenotype", drop = FALSE])

pheatmap(mat,
         scale = "row",
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         annotation_col = ann_col,
         main = "Top 500 most variable genes",
         cluster_cols = FALSE)

# ----------------------------
# Sample distance heatmap
# ----------------------------

sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)

rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- colnames(vsd)
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- colnames(vsd)

colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255)

pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols = sampleDists,
         col = colors)

# ----------------------------
# Differential expression
# ----------------------------

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("phenotype", "CHD8_KO", "WT"))
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]

summary(res)

resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds,
                    contrast = c("phenotype", "CHD8_KO", "WT"),
                    type = "apeglm")

# ----------------------------
# MA Plot
# ----------------------------

plotMA(resLFC, ylim = c(-5,5))

# ----------------------------
# Significance summary
# ----------------------------

cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05): ",
    sum(res$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("Upregulated genes: ",
    sum(res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("Downregulated genes: ",
    sum(res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ----------------------------
# Top 10 genes
# ----------------------------

top_genes <- head(resLFC[order(resLFC$padj), ], 10)
top_genes

par(mfrow = c(3,3))
for(i in 1:min(9, nrow(top_genes))){
  plotCounts(dds,
             gene = rownames(top_genes)[i],
             intgroup = "phenotype")
}
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

# ----------------------------
# Volcano plot
# ----------------------------

res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj), ]

plot(res_df$log2FoldChange,
     -log10(res_df$pvalue),
     pch = 20,
     main = "Volcano plot",
     xlim = c(-3,3))

sig <- res_df$padj < 0.05
points(res_df$log2FoldChange[sig],
       -log10(res_df$pvalue[sig]),
       col = "blue",
       pch = 20)

# ----------------------------
# GSEA
# ----------------------------

msig_mouse <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus",
                      category = "C5") %>%
  select(gs_name, ensembl_gene) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ensembl_gene), ensembl_gene != "") %>%
  distinct()

pathways <- split(msig_mouse$ensembl_gene,
                  msig_mouse$gs_name)

rank_tbl <- as.data.frame(resLFC)
rank_tbl$ENSEMBL <- rownames(rank_tbl)

ranks <- rank_tbl$log2FoldChange
names(ranks) <- rank_tbl$ENSEMBL
ranks <- ranks[!is.na(ranks)]
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

set.seed(1)
fg <- fgsea(pathways = pathways,
            stats = ranks,
            minSize = 15,
            maxSize = 500) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      arrange(padj)

head(fg[, c("pathway", "NES", "pval", "padj")], 20)

# ----------------------------
# Save DEG results
# ----------------------------

dir.create("results/DEG", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(as.data.frame(res),
          "results/DEG/DESeq2_results_full.csv")

write.csv(as.data.frame(resLFC),
          "results/DEG/DESeq2_results_shrunken.csv")

write.csv(as.data.frame(top_genes),
          "results/DEG/top10_genes.csv")

write.csv(as.data.frame(fg),
          "results/DEG/GSEA_results.csv")
